data_fields.donor_constant: per government from data (defaults not read in context)

data_fields.name: event count
data_fields.donor_constant: target crew value at the event (count 0 = no change)

best_idea: An offense against one faction moves the player's standing with every faction by count times how much that faction likes the victim times a penalty, ignoring tiny attitudes, so standing spreads across factions and zones can tune the spread as data.
decision_why: Keep the attitude-weighted spread with its 5 percent cut-off, the per-faction min and max clamp, the one-charge-per-event-per-ship rule, and the standing gate for zone entry; store standing in the one character ledger; drop the daily provocation flag (duels have no day cycle) and the atrocity wipe until design signs it off.
acceptance: A server test: a kill of faction A with count 3, attitude 0.5 toward B, penalty 1.0 lowers the player's standing with B by 1.5 and leaves C (attitude 0.02) unchanged; a second kill of the same fighter charges nothing; zone B opens at standing 0 and closes at -2.
